name: 90项症状清单
instructions: 以下列出了可能使您感到痛苦或不适的问题，请根据最近一周您受这些问题困扰的程度，选择最符合的一项。
instructionsEn: Below is a list of problems that may cause you distress or discomfort. Please indicate how much you have been bothered by each problem during the past week, and choose the option that best applies.

items.textEn: Headache
Nervousness or shakiness inside

items.text: 头脑中有不必要的想法或字句盘旋
items.textEn: Repeated thoughts intrude that you cannot get rid of
Faintness or dizziness
Loss of interest in the opposite sex
Being critical of others

items.text: 感到别人能控制您的思想
items.textEn: The idea that someone else can control your thoughts
Blaming others for your problems
Forgetfulness

items.text: 担心自己的衣饰整齐及仪态的端正
items.textEn: Worried about the tidiness of your clothes and your bearing
Easily irritated and agitated
Chest pains

items.text: 害怕空旷的场所或街道
items.textEn: Afraid of open places or streets

items.text: 感到自己的精力下降，活动减慢
items.textEn: Feeling low in energy or slowed down
Thoughts of ending your life

items.text: 听到旁人所不到的声音
items.textEn: Hearing voices that other people do not hear
Trembling

items.text: 感到大多数人都不可信任
items.textEn: Feeling that most people cannot be trusted
Poor appetite
Crying easily

items.text: 同异性相处时感到害羞不自在
items.textEn: Feeling shy or uneasy with the opposite sex

items.text: 感到受骗、中了圈套或有人想抓住您
items.textEn: Feelings of being trapped, caught, or pinned down

items.text: 无缘无故地突然感到害怕
items.textEn: Suddenly scared for no reason

items.text: 自己不能控制地大发脾气
items.textEn: Episodes of temper you cannot control
Afraid to go out of your house alone
Blaming yourself for things
Pains in the lower back
Feeling blocked in getting things done
Feeling lonely
Feeling blue
Worrying too much about things
Not feeling interested in things
Feeling fearful

items.text: 我的感情容易受到伤害
items.textEn: Your feelings being easily hurt

items.text: 旁人能知道您的私下想法
items.textEn: Other people being aware of your private thoughts

items.text: 感到别人不理解您、不同情您
items.textEn: Feeling others do not understand you or are unsympathetic

items.text: 感到人们对您不友好、不喜欢您
items.textEn: Feeling that people are unfriendly or dislike you

items.text: 做事必须做得很慢以保证做得正确
items.textEn: Having to do things very slowly to ensure accuracy
Heart pounding or racing
Nausea or upset stomach
Feeling inferior to others
Soreness of your muscles

items.text: 感到有人在监视您、谈论您
items.textEn: Feeling that you are being watched or talked about by others
Trouble falling asleep
Have to check things repeatedly
Difficulty making decisions

items.text: 怕乘电车、公共汽车、地铁或火车
items.textEn: Feeling afraid to travel on trolleys, buses, subways, or trains
Trouble getting your breath
Hot or cold spells

items.text: 因为感到害怕而避开某些东西、场合或活动
items.textEn: Having to avoid certain things, places, or activities because they frighten you
Your mind going blank
Numbness or tingling in parts of your body
A lump in your throat
Feeling hopeless about the future
Trouble concentrating

items.text: 感到身体的某一部分软弱无力
items.textEn: Feeling weak in parts of your body
Feeling tense or keyed up
Heavy feelings in your arms or legs
Thoughts of death or dying
Overeating

items.text: 当别人看着您或谈论您时感到不自在
items.textEn: Feeling uneasy when people are watching or talking about you

items.text: 有一些不属于您自己的想法
items.textEn: Having thoughts that are not your own

items.text: 有想打人或伤害他人的冲动
items.textEn: Having urges to beat, harm, or hurt someone
Awakening in the early morning

items.text: 必须反复洗手、点数目或触摸某些东西
items.textEn: Having to repeat the same actions such as washing, counting, or touching
Sleep that is restless or disturbed

items.text: 有想摔坏或破坏东西的冲动
items.textEn: Having urges to break or smash things

items.text: 有一些别人没有的想法或念头
items.textEn: Having ideas or beliefs that other people do not share
Feeling overly nervous and sensitive around others

items.text: 在商店或电影院等人多的地方感到不自在
items.textEn: Feeling uncomfortable in crowded places such as shops or cinemas

items.text: 感到任何事情都很困难
items.textEn: Feeling everything is an effort
Spells of panic or terror

items.text: 感到在公共场合吃东西很不舒服
items.textEn: Feeling uneasy eating or drinking in public places
Getting into frequent arguments

items.text: 单独一人时神经很紧张
items.textEn: Feeling nervous when you are alone

items.text: 别人对您的成绩没有作出恰当的评价
items.textEn: Others not giving you proper credit for your achievements

items.text: 即使和别人在一起也感到孤单
items.textEn: Feeling lonely even when you are with people

items.text: 感到坐立不安、心神不定
items.textEn: Feeling so restless you cannot sit still

items.text: 感到自己没有什么价值
items.textEn: Feelings of worthlessness

items.text: 感到熟悉的东西变成陌生或不像是真的
items.textEn: Feeling that familiar things are unreal or strange
Shouting or throwing things

items.text: 害怕会在公共场合昏倒
items.textEn: Feeling afraid you will faint in public

items.text: 感到别人想占您的便宜
items.textEn: Feeling that people will take advantage of you if you let them

items.text: 为一些有关“性”的想法而很苦恼
items.textEn: Having thoughts about sex that bother you a lot

items.text: 您认为应该因为自己的过错而受到惩罚
items.textEn: The idea that you should be punished for your sins

items.text: 感到要赶快把事情做完
items.textEn: Feeling driven to get things done

items.text: 感到自己的身体有严重问题
items.textEn: Feeling that something serious is wrong with your body

items.text: 从未感到和其他人很亲近
items.textEn: Never feeling close to another person
Feelings of guilt

items.text: 感到自己的脑子有毛病
items.textEn: Something is wrong with your mind

totalBands.description: 总均分低于1.5，总体未提示明显心理症状。
总均分1.5-2.5，提示存在轻度心理不适。
总均分2.5-3.5，提示存在中度心理不适，建议寻求专业评估。
总均分3.5及以上，提示存在明显心理症状，请尽快寻求专业帮助。

bands.description: 因子均分低于2，未见明显躯体化症状。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度躯体化不适。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显躯体化症状。
因子均分低于2，未见明显强迫症状。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度强迫症状。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显强迫症状。
因子均分低于2，未见明显人际关系敏感。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度人际关系敏感。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显人际关系敏感。
因子均分低于2，未见明显抑郁症状。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度抑郁症状。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显抑郁症状。
因子均分低于2，未见明显焦虑症状。

因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显焦虑症状。
因子均分低于2，未见明显敌对情绪。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度敌对情绪。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显敌对情绪。
因子均分低于2，未见明显恐怖症状。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度恐怖症状。
因子均分达到3及以上，提示明显恐怖症状。
因子均分低于2，未见明显偏执观念。
因子均分达到2，达到阳性筛查线，提示轻度偏执观念。

crisis.message: 您在第15题（想结束自己的生命）上回答为“中等”或以上。如果您正处于危机之中或感到不安全，请立即联系当地急救电话或心理援助热线，或告诉身边可信任的人。
